package.description: Generate SRT/ASS subtitles from any video with local AI and auto-translate them, offline.

en-US.description: Generate SRT/ASS subtitles from any video with local AI and auto-translate them, offline.
en-US.longDescription: Can't find subtitles for a video? Wave Subs recognizes the dialogue with whisper.cpp, refines the timing, and translates the result into your language with a local Qwen3 model (or any OpenAI-compatible API). Exports SRT / ASS next to the video, batch-processes a whole season, and includes a subtitle editor with video preview. Everything runs on your own computer: no account, no upload, no internet needed after the one-time model download. Free and open source (MIT).
en-US.name: Wave Subs

zh-CN.description: 用本地 AI 从影片生成 SRT/ASS 字幕并自动翻译，无需联网。
zh-CN.longDescription: 看片找不到字幕？Wave Subs 用 whisper.cpp 识别对白、精修时间轴，再用本地 Qwen3 模型（或任何 OpenAI 兼容接口）翻译成你的语言。导出 SRT / ASS 到影片旁边，整季批量处理，自带带视频预览的字幕编辑器。全部在你自己的电脑上完成：没有账号、不上传、模型下载后无需联网。免费开源（MIT）。
zh-CN.name: Wave Subs
